verdicts.reason: HNAP SetWanSettings handler (0x470758) feeds the user-controlled request fields ConfigDNS/Primary and ConfigDNS/Secondary (obtained via webGetVarString) as args 5/6 into static helper sub_46eaf8, which sprintf's Primary into a 64-byte stack buffer and then strcat's Secondary onto it with no bounds check (strcat@0x46ebc8) — a crafted HTTP request with an oversized DNS field smashes the CGI process stack, matching the CVE-2022-31414 description of a buffer overflow via strcat in prog.cgi causing DoS; no patch/length-filter trace found (sibling helpers sub_46f504 et al. share the same pattern).
